title: copilot-survey free-text codebook
description: Categories for coding the free text of one survey series (#2239). One file per series, <series>.json. A version is locked before coding starts; waves compare only when coded with the same version, so any change to a category bumps version. Examples are synthetic: never a quote from an answer. copilot-survey also checks what a schema cannot express (unique category ids, exactly one catch-all, fields that exist in the series); see codebook_test.go.

series.description: The survey series the codebook belongs to.

version.description: Goes up on any change to rules or categories.

fields.description: Free-text fields coded with this book: a text question id, or <id>.other.

max_codes.description: Most categories one text can get.

rules.description: General coding rules, applied before the category definitions.

id.description: Stored in survey_freetext_codes.category; never reused for a different meaning.

kind.description: Benefit, problem, or the catch-all (exactly one, coded alone).

exclude.description: Hold utenfor, each naming where it goes instead.
